definitions.explanation: A small cage or box, often of plastic or mesh, for keeping insects one has caught.

examples.japanese: {虫|むし}かご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦セミ→セミ：09931_semi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put the cicada in the insect cage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{虫|むし}かご⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: During summer vacation I went into the hills with an insect cage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえた→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{虫|むし}かご⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: My son is carefully raising the rhinoceros beetle he caught in an insect cage.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
With a {虫捕|むしと}り⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧ (insect net) and a straw hat, the {虫|むし}かご is the classic picture of a child's summer vacation in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虫捕|むしと}り⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{虫|むし}かご: an insect net and cage
- {虫|むし}かご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in an insect cage

WRITING:
Also written {虫籠|むしかご}; ⟦{籠|かご}→籠：02577_kago⟧ is a basket or cage.
